thread:
Diego (infra): Quick sync — proposing we tweak the Wed triage/handoff cadence. Current 30m covers too much. Suggest 20m structured triage + 10m flexible followups. Thoughts?

Clara (eng-manager): I like shorter core meeting. Can we keep a standing 10m block for escalations if needed? Otherwise people drop.

Ben (oncall): +1 for 20/10. If we truncate, please publish a tight agenda ahead so oncall folks know what to prep.

Diego (infra): Agreed. Proposed agenda (20m):
• Quick health check (5m) — incidents > P2
• Assign escalation owners (5m)
• Short review of triage queue & ETA updates (7m)
• Blockers / handover notes (3m)

Diego (infra): Flexible 10m follows for any deep dives or immediate tickets. If none, we end early.

Alice (SRE lead): Works for me. Can we also rotate a "escalation lead" for each meeting (not necessarily oncall) so we have a single point for comms? 2-week rotation maybe.

Maya (backend): Happy to be escalation lead next Wed if that helps. Also can we add a line in agenda to confirm DB failover status when relevant?

Ben (oncall): Thanks Maya — please ping me if you need any queue context. For the rotation: maybe oncall week + one extra engineer, so primary & secondary.

Clara (eng-manager): Sounds good. I'll draft a rotation spreadsheet. Quick ask: can we try one trial week with the new format next Wed 09:00 PT? If yes, I'll update calendar invite.

Diego (infra): Let's do the trial. Calendar invite: Wed 09:00 PT (20m core + 10m optional). Zoom link will be same recurring. I'll add the agenda template in the event and a one-line prep checklist.

incident-bot: Open incidents summary — 3 total.
```
INC-2026-1146 P1 | auth-service latency spike — owner: Ben (oncall) — ETA: investigating
INC-2026-1182 P2 | embeddings infra timeout — owner: Maya — ETA: 2h
INC-2026-1199 P3 | telemetry missing spans — owner: data-team — ETA: EOD
```

Ben (oncall): Quick notes on INC-2026-1146 — root cause looks like a degraded Redis cluster slot migration. I've set a mitigation (traffic shift) and will handoff follow-ups to escalation lead.

Alice (SRE lead): For the trial, please ensure we capture action items in the meeting thread and tag the escalation owner. I'll monitor channel and step in if the P1 needs cross-team support.

Maya (backend): I'll take INC-2026-1182 through the triage in the flex 10m if no blockers.

Clara (eng-manager): Thanks team. Action items:
• Diego: update invite & add agenda template
• Clara: rotation sheet + post-week retrospective note
• Ben: short one-liner handoff for P1 in calendar event
• Maya: be escalation owner next Wed (confirmed)

Diego (infra): Done — invite updated and agenda in event. See link in event: https://zoom.redwood.example/triage. Will post a brief prep checklist in #eng-oncall tomorrow.

Ben (oncall): :thumbsup: See you all Wed 09:00 PT.

Clara (eng-manager): I'll run a 5m retrospective after the trial in the channel. If anyone can't make the core 20m, please add notes to the event or ping me.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: triage trial Wed 09:00 PT (recurring single-week trial)

Diego (infra): Closing loop here. If anything changes before Wed, flag in this thread.

Maya (backend): Thanks — I'll prepare a one-slide summary for the flexible slot.

Ben (oncall): Logged a quick handoff in the event description for INC-2026-1146.

Clara (eng-manager): Perfect — end of thread.
